AdmissibleAnswerOrStructure: numeric_triplet_by_enabled_family | 0 <= lower < reference < higher <= 1 for each enabled family

RequiredEvidence: policy/version identity with exact stratum order and weights summing to one
AdmissibleAnswerOrStructure: numeric_vector_by_family_and_stratum_count | nonnegative fixed weights sum to one in exact stratum order

AdmissibleAnswerOrStructure: external_identity_by_family_and_stratum_count | transformation is external, frozen, and does not use simulation outcomes

RequiredEvidence: prospective roster/topology identity showing the declared overlap pattern
AdmissibleAnswerOrStructure: external_operational_identity | one rater identity is common to every stratum and all others are disjoint

RequiredEvidence: cost ledger/version with rating-event unit and unique-rater overhead

RequiredEvidence: current allocation identifier and current action-rule identifier for S2 and S3
AdmissibleAnswerOrStructure: external_policy_identity | current allocation and action rule are fixed before outcomes

RequiredEvidence: feasibility evidence for every retained allocation coordinate
AdmissibleAnswerOrStructure: logical_by_stratum_count_and_allocation | every retained 2/3/4-rater by 1/2-repeat allocation is feasible

RequiredEvidence: decision policy/version mapping robust, conditional, and unsupported to actions
